|strategy=By [mailto:theguy@ionet.net Guy Kargl], Red 61<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20020804010401/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/light/small/warriorscourage.html</ref>

This is an absolutely WONDERFUL card that has always been useful, but has become incredibly useful with the release of Cloud City.

The first part of the game text says, "If any warrior is defending a battle alone at a site, add one battle destiny." This means [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] (or any warrior with ability of 4 or more) gets two battle destiny draws if he's defending a battle alone at a site! It also means that warriors who normally can't draw battle destiny get to draw one for this battle! This is usually enough to catch your opponent off guard, and make him lose a character or two at that site that he didn't want to.

However, it's the second part of the game text that I love. It says, "OR if [[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]] is defending a battle alone at a site, add two battle destiny." This was great when all we had was [[Leia Organa]] - it meant that she could draw two battle destiny and really surprise your opponent!

Yet with the release of Cloud City, we have a new personna of [[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]] - [[Princess Leia]]. This "[[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]]" can draw one battle destiny all by herself because she has an ability of 4. So, if you play [[Warrior's Courage]] on [[Princess Leia]], you get a total of THREE battle destiny! Who wouldn't be surprised by that?

I used this combo one time, and [[Princess Leia]] took out [[Blizzard 1]] AND [[General Veers]]!

Combo: [[Princess Leia]] + [[Warrior's Courage]] = THREE battle destiny draws!
